title: Rv0678, MmpL5, and efflux
dek: mmpR5 (Rv0678) represses the MmpS5-MmpL5 efflux pump. Loss-of-function raises BDQ and often CFZ MICs. This is the common clinical BDQ path, and many alleles remain catalogue-uncertain.
story: Rv0678 encodes a MarR-family repressor (MmpR5) of the mmpS5-mmpL5 operon. Frameshifts, premature stops, and some missense alleles derepress MmpL5, pumping out bedaquiline and, overlapping, clofazimine. MIC shifts are often modest — enough to matter under drug pressure, easy to miss with a blunt CC.
pepQ (a putative peptidase) is a third BDQ-associated locus with smaller, context-dependent shifts. atpE remains the rare high-level target path. A BDQ report that only lists atpE is a 2013 report.

WHO catalogue 2nd ed listed dozens of BDQ-associated variants, most in this regulator/pump axis, and a long uncertain tail. Do not over-call every Rv0678 missense as high-level R. Do not under-call a clear LOF frameshift.
deep: BDQ/CFZ cross-R is the default worry with Rv0678 LOF. It is not 100% coupled in magnitude. If a 9-month recipe was counting both, recount.
Full-gene Rv0678: variants scatter, like a tiny pncA. Hotspot panels will miss frameshifts outside the amplicon.
Mixed AF in Rv0678 during BDQ therapy is emerging resistance. Treat it as a clinical event.
Some lineage-associated Rv0678 SNPs are not LOF. Grade.

visual.caption: Intact Rv0678 represses MmpL5. LOF lifts repression, effluxes BDQ/CFZ, modestly shifts MIC. atpE is a separate, rarer high-level fork.

example.title: Uncertain missense, MIC 0.25
example.setup: Rv0678 missense graded uncertain. BDQ MIC at the upper WT edge. CFZ MIC unchanged. Team wants to stop BDQ.

steps.title: Uncertain means uncertain
steps.body: Do not treat every missense as a frameshift.

steps.title: Use the MIC
steps.body: Borderline MIC plus uncertain allele is a humility zone, not an automatic BPaLM abort — and not a free pass. Document, consider TDM/expert, watch cultures.

steps.title: Do not also drop CFZ “for solidarity” without data
steps.body: Cross-R is a prior, not a law, especially when CFZ MIC did not move.

example.takeaway: Rv0678 LOF ≠ every Rv0678 SNP. Grade + MIC.

choices: A repressor of MmpL5 efflux; LOF raises BDQ (±CFZ) MIC
